o01-lamp-on.observed_description: Ana on a grey sofa in a bright daytime room touches a small table lamp standing on a stack of books.
o01-lamp-on.note: REJECTED: daylight fills the room, so the lamp does not read as on, and it is a table lamp, not the floor lamp asked for; remade in v2 at night.

o03-tv-on.observed_description: Luis in a dark-blue armchair points a remote at a TV showing mountains and a lake in the evening.
o03-tv-on.note: REJECTED: a second forearm with a second remote rests on the armrest, so Luis appears to have three arms; remade in v2 with one remote.

o05-pc-on.observed_description: Diego (burgundy shirt, beard) types on a silver laptop at a wooden desk by a bright window; the screen shows a sunny beach.
o05-pc-on.note: Usable: the laptop is clearly on and his face matches the reference.

o06-pc-off.observed_description: The same photo of Diego at his laptop with the screen now plain black.
o06-pc-off.note: Usable: off reads at 180 px; only the screen changed.
